question: The Queen's Stepwell in Gujarat, known officially as Rani-ki-Vav, is situated along the course of which river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saraswati River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rani-ki-Vav**, also known as the Queen's Stepwell, is located in the **town of Patan**, Gujarat, India.
 
• It was constructed during the **11th century AD** by Queen Udayamati, who was the wife of King Bhimdev I of the Solanki dynasty.
 
• Rani-ki-Vav is situated along the course of the **Saraswati River**, which is a river of historical and mythological significance. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• The stepwell showcases intricate carvings, with over **500 sculptures** representing themes from mythology, religion, and daily life.
 
• It was designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site</stro
